title: A Counterexample To Universal Character Density For Compact Quantum Groups
summary: In 1987, Woronowicz asked whether the linear span of irreducible characters is norm dense in the cocommutative part of the ambient C-star algebra of a compact quantum group. After thirty-nine calendar years, we give a negative answer to the universal form of this question, even for compact matrix quantum groups of Kac type. Starting from an infinite finitely generated simple group with property T and a finite bicharacter twist, we construct a compact quantum group whose universal C-star algebra is a full group C-star algebra.
